messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: geom_text rendering
parts:
Hi All,

I'm in the process of updating my package (Deducer) to ggplot2 0.9,
and I'm checking my plotting functions to make sure that nothing
untoward has happened to them. I have a function that creates a roc
plot:


rocplot<-
function(logistic.model,diag=TRUE,pred.prob.labels=FALSE,prob.label.digits=3,AUC=TRUE)
{
##Adapted from lroc in epicalc
firsttable <- table(logistic.model$fitted.values, logistic.model$y)
colnames(firsttable) <- c("Non-diseased", "Diseased")
firsttable1 <- cbind(as.numeric(rownames(firsttable)), firsttable)
rownames(firsttable1) <- rep("", nrow(firsttable1))
colnames(firsttable1)[1] <- "predicted.prob"
secondtable <- firsttable
for (i in 1:length(secondtable[, 1])) {
secondtable[i, 1] <- (sum(firsttable[, 1]) - sum(firsttable[(1:i),
1]))/sum(firsttable[, 1])
secondtable[i, 2] <- (sum(firsttable[, 2]) - sum(firsttable[(1:i),
2]))/sum(firsttable[, 2])
rownames(secondtable)[i] <- rownames(secondtable)[i]
}
secondtable <- as.data.frame(rbind((c(1, 1)), secondtable))
colnames(secondtable) <- c("Spec", "Sens")
model.des <- paste("logit (", deparse(logistic.model$formula),
")", sep = "")
auc <- 0
for (i in 1:(nrow(secondtable) - 1)) {
auc <- auc + (secondtable[i, 1] - secondtable[(i + 1),
1]) * 0.5 * (secondtable[i, 2] + secondtable[(i +
1), 2])
}

p<-qplot(Spec, Sens,data=secondtable[nrow(secondtable):1,], xlab = "1-
Specificity",
ylab = "Sensitivity",main=model.des, xlim = (c(0, 1)), ylim = (c(0,
1)))+geom_step()
if(diag)
p<-p+geom_segment(aes(x=0,y=0),xend=1,yend=1,colour="red",size=1.5)
if(pred.prob.labels)
p<-p+geom_text(size=3,angle=-45,aes(x=Spec+.03,y=Sens-.03,

label=formatC(as.numeric(rownames(secondtable)),digits=prob.label.digits)))
if(AUC)
p<-p+geom_text(aes(x=.
8,y=0.05,label=paste("AUC=",formatC(auc,digits=4))))
p
}

It can be run with something like:

model.glm <- glm(formula=income>5930.5 ~ education + women +
type,family=binomial(),data=Prestige,na.action=na.omit)
rocplot(model.glm)

On my system, the label "AUC=0.9342" is rendered very poorly. I
checked it with pdf and JavaGD devices, and both had the same
rendering. Any thoughts?

Best,
Ian

messages.subject: Re: geom_text rendering
parts:
Hi,

The comment " label "AUC=0.9342" is rendered very poorly." would
suggest that the geom_text is overlaid multiple times. This is a
common issue, when the global mapping of the plot interferes with the
layer. One way around it is to explicitly pass a data argument,

geom_text(aes(x=x,y=y,label=label), data =
data.frame(x=.8,y=0.05,label=paste("AUC=",formatC(auc,digits=4))))

there used to be .inherit.aes=FALSE to that effect too, but I cannot
see it working here.

HTH,

b.

messages.subject: Re: geom_text rendering
parts:
Ahh, that's it. I just needed to pass the parameters directly rather
than through an aes:

geom_text(x=.8,y=0.05,label=paste("AUC=",formatC(auc,digits=4)))


It does seem to me that (ideally) the rendering should be the same not
matter how many identical objects are rendered.


Best,
Ian
